description:
Parent POM for platform-specific instances of jeap-mcp-service to inherit from.
        Declares the dependency on jeap-mcp-service-web so instance repos get it for free; each
        instance repo still configures its own spring-boot-maven-plugin mainClass and adds
        whichever platform-specific dependencies it needs - none of that belongs here, following
        the same pattern as jeap-archrepo-service/jeap-archrepo-instance.
